logfile.description: List of Apache access log files to monitor. Each string is a file path.

max_entries_type.description: Whether to limit entries by number of hits ('hits') or by time window ('time').

max_entries_count.description: When max_entries_type='hits', max number of hits to remember (e.g., 5000). When max_entries_type='time', time window in seconds (e.g., 30).

preserve_querystring.description: If true, preserve query strings in URLs (equivalent to -q).

lowercase_urls.description: If true, lowercase all URLs so /FOO and /foo are merged (equivalent to -l).

path_segments.description: Number of path segments to keep (e.g., 3 keeps /a/b/). If zero or negative, disabled.

preserve_protocol.description: If true, preserve the protocol (http://) in referrer strings (equivalent to -p).

refresh_delay.description: Screen refresh delay in seconds (equivalent to -r). Must be ≥1. Default 2.
